About the Role
Australasian Stone is seeking a skilled and reliable Stonemason to join our growing team in Mount Waverley. As a premier provider of waterproofing, tiling, and stone masonry services across Melbourne's commercial and civil construction sectors, we take pride in the precision and craftsmanship of everything we deliver. In this role, you will work alongside a team of over 100 dedicated trade professionals, contributing to projects that range from commercial high-rises to civil infrastructure developments.
This is an opportunity to bring your trade skills to a business that values quality, takes its work seriously, and gives its people the projects and support to do their best work.

Key Responsibilities
- Interpret complex blueprints and technical specifications to ensure accurate material planning, site preparation, and project execution.
- Utilize advanced machinery and manual techniques for the precise cutting, shaping, and finishing of stone and masonry components to meet exact project tolerances.
- Construct structural and aesthetic masonry installations, ensuring integrity and adherence to architectural design requirements.
- Apply binding agents and mortars to secure masonry units, maintaining structural alignment, consistent jointing, and required leveling standards.
- Implement moisture-proofing and protective sealing measures to ensure the long-term durability and structural integrity of foundations and surfaces.
- Coordinate the safe setup and dismantling of work platforms and low-level scaffolding in compliance with site safety regulations.
- Perform comprehensive maintenance, repair, and restoration services on existing masonry and stonework installations.
- Deliver specialized masonry services, including intricate design work and custom detailing, as necessitated by specific project scopes.

About You
- Trade-qualified with an AQF Certificate III or IV in stonemasonry, or a related discipline, or a minimum of three years relevant experience in lieu
- Demonstrated hands-on experience laying bricks, blocks, or stonework in a commercial or civil construction environment
- Strong attention to detail with a commitment to delivering accurate, high-quality finishes
- Able to read and interpret technical plans and specifications
- Physically fit and capable of performing the demands of the role safely
- Holds, or is eligible to obtain, any required registration or licensing
- A reliable team player with a professional approach to work and safety on site

Trading under Publicis Communications Australia
Role: Technical Lead
Location: Sydney

Who we are

Consumer habits are anything but linear, and attention must be earned. At Digitas, we understand that, to break through, brands must be surprising, entertaining and authentic. 

Driven by imagination and fueled by deep cultural, consumer and business insights, we craft impactful creative experiences across every medium — from integrated campaigns, gaming, and physical experiences to full-length feature films. 

We earn the right for brands to be part of their customers’ networks. We drive growth with our amazing clients, through our capabilities in Consulting, Products & Platforms, Customer Engagement and Digital Media.

Part of Publicis Groupe, and a Leader in Gartner’s Magic Quadrant for Global Marketing Agencies, we’re proud to work with some of the world’s leading brands.

Digitas – The Networked Experience Agency


The role:

The purpose of this role is to lead the technical design and delivery of impactful customer engagement solutions using the Braze platform, focused on a single, high-profile client with room to grow across the agency. As the Technical Lead, you will translate creative ideas into actionable Braze and data solutions, ensuring seamless execution. You will collaborate with stakeholders, develop prototypes, mentor technical teams, and maintain high standards for performance, documentation, and innovation.

This role focuses on 2 core areas:
1.	Technical leadership and solution design 
2.	Stakeholder collaboration and team development

 
Day to day you’ll get:

•	Work cross-functionally with the client and our account, creative, strategy and analytics teams to translate creative ideas into technical and data requirements for the Braze platform. Your vision will ensure client success from idea to implementation. 
•	Scope/build rapid prototypes which help us to respond to client briefs and assess technical viability.
•	Be the main point of contact when it comes to data requirements for Braze. Liaise with internal and external teams to ensure that we are leveraging client data securely, effectively and efficiently.
Ensure that all solutions are endorsed and supported by our client’s global and local technology teams and that all established standards are adhered to.
•	Be the absolute subject matter expert for our internal team and clients when it comes to the Braze platform 
•	Advise and mentor a local/offshore technical delivery team, fostering growth, capability and process.  
•	Work with the Digitas tech team to troubleshoot, test, and optimize solutions to achieve maximum performance with minimal errors.
Ensure continuity for the account by establishing and maintaining standards across the tech team for documentation and knowledge exchange.

Skills:
•	Expert level on-tool skills with one of the major customer engagement platforms (Salesforce, Adobe, Braze) 
•	Candidates with Braze experience are preferred. 
•	Salesforce, Braze or other certifications are a plus but not required
•	Ability to quickly learn new systems and processes.
•	Strong working knowledge of modern marketing data tools and integration patterns with an emphasis on how to solution data for targeting, personalisation and reporting 
•	Working knowledge of CDPs such as Segment, Tealium and mParticle. mParticle experience is a huge plus 
•	Analytical thinking, asking the right questions and challenging for better outcomes  
•	Strategic thinker, pushing the boundaries and always challenging us to think bigger or differently
•	Excellent collaboration, written and verbal communication skills

The person we are looking for has:

•	7+ years of experience working on the technical side of Martech, marketing automation or customer engagement roles
•	Background in prototyping and light coding. Minimally you should be strong in basic web languages (HTML, CSS, JS) and scripting languages such as Liquid or ActionScript. 
•	2+ years of experience articulating solution designs with Martech platforms
•	Proven track record of successful solution design work 
•	Experience working with complex data environments which depend on streaming data 
•	Experience managing and mentoring technical delivery teams
•	Bonus points for prior agency/consultancy experience, as well as working with/leading off-shore delivery teams

Got what it takes? We’d love to hear from you.

Our offer to you:

Be a part of the Publicis Groupe family, one of the world’s most progressive and dynamic modern communications businesses enjoying all the perks that come with our network offering:
•	Work with a diverse team where we value all the benefits of harnessing differences for our people, our clients and our business.
•	A committed Diversity Inclusion and Belonging strategy are driven through our Viva! Women, Tahi Katoa, Wholeself and Égalité programs
•	A creative, fun and rewarding office environment backed up by our Publicis Liberté flexibility approach
•	Access to employee benefits including – wellness programmes, learning and development opportunities, and network events
•	Day off on your birthday.

If you don’t tick every box in this ad, please don’t rule yourself out.  We focus on hiring people who share our values of inclusion, collaboration, adaptability, fearlessness, and integrity, rather than ticking boxes – so if this role resonates with you, please apply.

Diversity. Inclusion. Equity. More than just words, these are part of our DNA. 

At Publicis Groupe we are committed to the inclusion and recognition of all people; regardless of race, age, culture, ability, ethnicity, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status and religious affiliation. We believe that to deliver the best solutions to our clients, our people need to reflect the diverse communities in which our clients operate in. We value diversity and the skills, knowledge and experience that difference brings to our culture and solutions. 

Uniqueness is powerful; without it we wouldn’t be where we are today. So be you – we like it that way. 

We are committed to providing reasonable adjustments for people with disability or those that require additional support throughout the application process.  

Salary: Over threshold

result.description:
At Qantas, our teams come together to create new and unique experiences for our customers 
A fantastic opportunity to lead product design within a squad to deliver world class products for our cabin crew
Full-time permanent position based at our new Product and Innovation Centre in Adelaide   

Join Qantas in our brand-new Product and Innovation Centre located in Adelaide to help meet evolving consumer needs by enabling agile teams to deliver faster, more adaptive solutions that prioritise customer value, continuous feedback, and innovation at every stage of the product lifecycle.

Are you passionate about crafting great mobile experiences? As a Senior Product Designer, you’ll lead the design of mobile tools for our cabin crew, shaping strategy and delivering scalable, high-quality solutions that balance the needs of our people, the business, and the customer experience. If you’re ready to make a real impact, we’d love to hear from you.

You'll be hands-on across the entire product journey—from discovering fresh ideas and digging into research, to shaping the experience and seeing your designs through to launch and ongoing improvement. You'll work closely with Product, Engineering, Operations and Service teams, making sure we deliver seamless, end-to-end experiences for our people and that your design vision stays front and centre from concept to delivery.

You'll set the standard for quality and act as a trusted advisor, guiding your teammates to lift their skills and ways of working. Part of your impact will be making the most of AI-enabled tools to boost insight, creativity, and efficiency—always keeping design judgement, accessibility and our brand in mind. If you love sharing your knowledge and raising the bar for design, we'd love to welcome you aboard!

We're keen to meet designers who are curious and hands-on with AI in their workflow. If you've played around with the latest AI-powered design tools, or have fresh ideas for using AI to spark creativity, speed up prototyping or make delivery smoother, you'll fit right in. Show us how you've used AI to improve your creative process or enhance user outcomes—we're excited to see your practical approach and innovative thinking.

You’ll have:

7+ years of experience in Service Design, UX, UI, CX, and/or a similar role.
Tertiary qualification in Design, Human-Centered Design (HCD), or a relevant field. 
Strong understanding of design for native apps, conversational interfaces, and other digital platforms.
Strategic thinking to deliver innovative outcomes aligned with brief and brand.
Ability to focus on objectives and deliverables at both technical and creative levels,
always user-centric.
Experience developing and promoting a product vision collaboratively.
Experienced in concept development, wireframing, persona creation, user stories and
user testing.
Experience working with design systems and creating user interface.
Proficiency in modern frameworks and rituals: Lean, Design Thinking, Scrum,
Kanban.
Thorough knowledge of usability and accessibility standards, including WCAG 2.0
AA.
Experience using modern industry tools such as Miro, Figma, Lovable, ClaudeCode,
Cursor, and Adobe Creative Suite; collaboration tools like JIRA and Confluence.
Practical experience using AI tools to streamline design handover to developers and
generate code (e.g., Figma's AI plugins, ClaudeCode, Cursor, Lovable).
Advanced logical reasoning and sound decision-making, including numerical
analysis.
Ability to identify and address flawed logic and coach teams to resolve errors. 
Proven ability to solve high-impact design challenges in large, complex
organisations.
Expert facilitation skills, with a track record of successful outcomes.
Inspirational leadership for both direct and remote teams.
Clear communication of design concepts to stakeholders, adapting to the audience.
Extensive knowledge of current digital design standards and industry trends.
Why Qantas?

At Qantas, your career can take you further than you imagined. You’ll join a team where creativity and passion drives success. Together we dream big and deliver even bigger.? 

You’ll find diverse opportunities to grow, personally and professionally. From day one, you’ll be supported with hands-on training, coaching, and formal learning programs designed to help you excel. Your development is our priority because we know that when you thrive, so do our customers. 

And while this role is your starting point at Qantas, it’s just the beginning. We have a proud history of helping our people explore new paths and reach new heights - the destinations are endless. 

The Qantas employee benefits program offers amazing benefits that extend well beyond travel.? 

We love to travel: Enjoy heavily discounted air travel within Australia and across the globe, both for you and your family and friends, as well as exclusive deals on accommodation and holidays. 
We have flexible leave options: Make use of leave and flexible working opportunities including 18 weeks paid parental leave and the option to purchase additional paid leave for eligible employees.  
We’ll give you access to thousands of rewards: Through our partnerships we can offer you discounts across shopping, food and wine, insurance, health and wellbeing, leisure and entertainment.?You can also take advantage of our salary packaging program including motor vehicles, eligible portable electronic devices and professional memberships.  
We’ll support your wellbeing: Whether it’s learning to better support your own and others’ mental health, our interactive wellbeing app or your very own tailored nutrition plan.?
Be a part of something special and play your part in the Qantas story – get in touch today.

Applications close on the 20th of August

Qantas is an equal opportunity employer committed to providing a working environment that embraces and values diversity and inclusion.  We encourage Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander, and people of all backgrounds to apply.  If you have any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at time of application.  Your personal information will be kept confidential in compliance with relevant privacy legislation.

Shepparton Golf Club Inc.

$80,000 – $84,000 per year + super | Full-time (38 Hours a week)
15 Golf Drive, Shepparton VIC 3630, Australia

The Shepparton Golf Club is a licensed club venue seeking a passionate and talented Hospitality Manager to join our dynamic team. Set among beautifully maintained greens and a welcoming community atmosphere, our club is committed to delivering exceptional dining experiences for members, guests, and event clientele.

About the Role

As Hospitality Manager, you will play a key leadership role in our Food & Beverage area—supporting the General manager in day-to-day operations, The successful candidate will oversee daily operations, manage staff, maintain high service standards, and ensure the smooth and efficient running of the venue. 
Key Responsibilities
•	Planning and supervising bar, bistro and function services
•	Lead, train, and motivate front-of-house and support staff.
•	Deliver outstanding customer service and resolve guest concerns professionally.
•	Monitor staffing levels, rosters, and labour costs.
•	Ensure compliance with food safety, health, and workplace safety regulations.
•	Maintain high standards of cleanliness, presentation, and service quality.
•	Manage stock control, ordering, and supplier relationships.
•	Assist with budgeting, reporting, and achieving financial targets.
•	Support marketing initiatives and special events.

About You
•	Previous experience in a hospitality leadership role.
•	Excellent leadership and communication skills.
•	Strong organisational and problem-solving abilities.
•	Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
•	Sound knowledge of food safety and workplace health and safety requirements.
•	Responsible Service of Alcohol (RSA) certificate.
•	A passion for delivering exceptional customer experiences.
•	Diploma of Hospitality management or equivalent.

Why Join Us?
•	Work in a friendly, community-focused club environment
•	Supportive leadership and opportunities for professional growth
•	Great work–life balance compared to many hospitality venues
•	Opportunity to contribute to an evolving and creative food offering

How to Apply

If you’re ready to take the next step in your hospitality career, we’d love to hear from you.
Please send a cover letter and resume with references to manager@sheppartongolf.net.au

ABOUT US:
Mizar Partners Pty Ltd is an Australian professional accounting and business advisory firm with offices in Melbourne and Sydney. We provide accounting, taxation, compliance and business advisory services to individuals, sole traders, small and medium-sized businesses, and corporate clients across a wide range of industries.
Our services include bookkeeping, management accounting, taxation, tax planning, business advisory, cash flow management, SMSF support, entity structure advice, financial reporting and compliance support. We focus on providing practical accounting and taxation solutions to help clients maintain accurate financial records, meet their statutory obligations, understand their financial position and make informed business decisions.
Vacant Position: Senior Accountant 
We are seeking an experienced Accountant to join our senior level service team on a full-time basis. The successful applicant will be responsible for preparing, reviewing, analysing financial and taxation information for clients, assisting with statutory compliance, preparing financial statements and tax returns, supporting business advisory work, and providing professional accounting support across a range of client matters.
This role is suited to a professional with strong technical knowledge in accounting, taxation, financial reporting, business compliance, accounting systems, budget analysis, cash flow management and client advisory services.
Hiring Type: Permanent Full-time
Salary Range: Above AUD82,000 + super/ per year 
(The remuneration will depend on the skills, outcomes and experience you can deliver. )
Working Location: Melbourne
Qualification Requirements:
•	Above Master’s degree from Australia or overseas tertiary education provider is a must;
•	Must have a minimum of 3 years’ relevant accounting experience in public practice or business services.
•	Strong communication skills required, including proficiency in English and Mandarin.
•	Hands-on public practice experience delivering end-to-end tax, BAS and financial reporting services for Australian SME.
•	In-depth working knowledge of ATO legislation, payroll compliance, FBT, GST, PAYG and superannuation regulatory rules.
•	Strong proficiency with cloud accounting platforms and advanced Excel for financial modelling and reconciliation.
•	CPA/CA qualified or currently undertaking professional accounting accreditation will highly regarded.
•	Strong knowledge of Australian taxation law and compliance requirements.
•	Clear written and verbal communication skills to deliver straightforward financial advice to non- 
financial business owners.
•	Strong attention to detail and problem-solving ability.

Roles and Responsibility:
This is a senior level accounting service role, with core duties including:
?	Conduct payroll reviews fully compliant with ATO standards, including superannuation contribution calculations and salary packaging deduction audits.
?	Prepare month-end accounting deliverables: cash flow statements, journal entries, ad-hoc performance reports, monthly budgets, balance sheets and formal management reporting packs.
?	Prepare, reconcile and lodge all compliance documentation including Business Activity Statements (BAS), individual, company, partnership and super fund tax returns covering GST, PAYG instalments, PAYG withholding and all statutory tax obligations.
?	Design, update and refine internal financial workflows and general accounting procedures to boost operational efficiency and accuracy.
?	Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support for cloud-based accounting software systems used by internal teams and SME clients.
?	Compile complete financial statements (balance sheet, profit & loss, cash flow statements), conduct line-by-line account reviews and general ledger reconciliations, and deliver profitability, liquidity and financial health analysis to firm management and directors.
?	Prepare, validate and submit accurate annual Fringe Benefits Tax (FBT) filings for all client entities.
?	Deliver customised professional taxation and structural advice to clients covering business setup,     
growth planning and daily operational financial optimisation.
?	Build robust financial control frameworks to protect client asset integrity, analyse operational expenses and track organisational income and expenditure trends.
?	Serve as the primary liaison for external auditors and support interim and year-end statutory audit procedures for all client portfolios.
?	Correspond and negotiate directly with the Australian Taxation Office (ATO) and other financial regulatory authorities as required for client compliance matters.
?	Identify legitimate tax minimisation opportunities, eligible claim deductions and profit-improvement strategies for individual and business clients.

Retail Manager–  Northcote

About Us

Kogan People Solutions, recruiters,  is working  is a growing retail food business specialising in Korean-style fried chicken who are seeking their new Retail Manager. The business operates through takeaway, customer pickups and third-party delivery platforms, supported by state of the art integrated retail technology and digital ordering systems.

As part of their long-term growth strategy, our client is investing in scalable retail systems, operational consistency and commercial processes to support future expansion across multiple locations.

•	Location: Northcote, VIC

•	Employment Type: Full-time, ongoing

•	Salary: Negotiable in the range $80,000 – $85,000 per annum plus superannuation

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Retail Manager to oversee the commercial and operational management of our retail business. The successful candidate will be responsible for driving business performance, managing staff, coordinating inventory and purchasing activities, maintaining compliance with company policies, and implementing operational systems that improve efficiency and support business growth.

The role requires a commercially focused manager with strong leadership, financial administration and business systems experience who can optimise retail operations across multiple sites while ensuring high standards of customer service and operational performance.

Key Responsibilities

•	Manage the day-to-day operation of the retail business to achieve sales, profitability and customer service objectives. 

•	Develop and implement business strategies to improve operational efficiency, sales performance and overall profitability. 

•	Monitor sales performance, analyse trading results and prepare operational and financial reports for management. 

•	Manage retail budgets, expenses and cost control initiatives while supporting pricing and promotional strategies. 

•	Coordinate inventory management, purchasing activities and supplier relationships to ensure product availability and minimise stock losses.
 
•	Monitor stock movement and inventory records, ensuring accurate stock control and reconciliation procedures. 

•	Recruit, supervise, train and performance manage employees, including workforce planning, rostering and payroll administration using workforce management systems. 

•	Develop, implement and maintain operational procedures, policies and staff training programs to ensure consistent business practices. 

•	Ensure compliance with workplace health and safety requirements, food retail regulations, company policies and other statutory obligations. 

•	Manage customer service standards, respond to customer enquiries and resolve complaints to maintain high levels of customer satisfaction.
 
•	Coordinate the implementation and ongoing improvement of retail technology, point-of-sale systems and operational software to enhance business performance. 

•	Identify opportunities to improve business processes and support the development of systems suitable for future multi-site operations. 

Skills & Experience Required to be considered

•	Diploma or higher in Business, Management, Commerce or a closely related discipline or agreed substitute

•	At least one or more years of experience,  managing retail operations, preferably within a high-volume retail or food retail environment. 

•	Demonstrated experience in financial administration, budgeting, reporting and cost management. 

•	Experience managing inventory systems, purchasing processes and supplier relationships. 

•	Strong knowledge of retail workforce planning, payroll administration and employee supervision. 

•	Experience implementing and maintaining retail operating procedures and business systems. 

•	Sound understanding of workplace health and safety requirements and regulatory compliance. 

•	Strong analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills with the ability to make commercial decisions. 

•	Excellent leadership, communication and customer service skills. 

•	Experience using retail management software, point-of-sale systems and workforce management platforms such as Deputy is highly desirable. 

•	Valid unrestricted Victorian drivers license

You must have unrestricted rights to work full time in Australia to apply for this position. 

Why Join Us?

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing retail business focused on innovation, operational excellence and future expansion. You will play a key role in developing scalable retail systems, improving commercial performance and supporting the continued growth of the business.

Applications

Please respond to the recruiters using the facilities on this site, and ensure you attach your updated CV.

Kogan People Solutions are grateful for all applications, but kindly note that they will only respond to shortlisted applicants.

Kogan People Solutions – recruitment excellence

Operations & Service Delivery Manager

Stabilise Performance. Strengthen Compliance. Drive Sustainable Growth.

Your Story Community Supports is a growing NDIS provider delivering Supported Independent Living (SIL) and community participation services across Western Sydney.

We are seeking an experienced Operations & Service Delivery Manager to take full operational accountability across our service streams. This senior leadership role is responsible for operational performance, workforce management, compliance, financial sustainability and structured growth.

We need a strong operator—someone who builds effective systems, drives accountability and ensures services operate safely, efficiently and sustainably.

The Role

Reporting directly to the Director, you will oversee the performance and operation of all service delivery functions.

Key responsibilities include:

Operational leadership

- Oversee day-to-day service delivery across SIL and community supports.
- Lead Team Leaders, Coordinators and frontline teams.
-Manage workforce planning, rostering, staffing ratios and utilisation.
- Establish structured supervision and performance-management frameworks.
-Oversee incident management, safeguarding and risk mitigation.
-Ensure compliance with the NDIS Practice Standards and NDIS Quality and Safeguards Commission requirements.
-Lead audit preparation and maintain ongoing regulatory readiness.

Financial and performance oversight

-Own operational KPIs and service-utilisation targets.
-Monitor staffing costs, budgets and financial sustainability.
-Maintain SIL occupancy and implement vacancy-management strategies.
-Establish clear operational reporting frameworks.
-Deliver monthly performance reports to the Director.

Systems and governance

-Strengthen internal processes and reduce operational risk.
-Establish clear responsibilities and accountability across teams.
-Improve documentation standards and compliance workflows.
-Ensure workforce practices align with the SCHADS Award.
-Coordinate recruitment planning according to operational demand.

Sustainable growth and sector engagement

-Strengthen referral pathways and participant intake processes.
-Develop professional relationships with Support Coordinators, allied health professionals and sector partners.
-Monitor referral activity, conversion rates and service commencement.
-Identify responsible expansion opportunities aligned with workforce and operational capacity.

About You

You are an experienced NDIS operational leader who understands both regulatory obligations and commercial performance. You are structured, analytical and comfortable being accountable for measurable outcomes.

You will bring:

-At least five years’ experience in disability services, including SIL.
-Demonstrated experience leading multi-site or multi-team operations.
-Strong knowledge of the NDIS Practice Standards and compliance frameworks.
-Proven experience managing workforce utilisation, staffing ratios and budgets.
-Confidence undertaking performance management and making operational decisions.
-Experience supporting complex participants and managing high-risk environments.
-Strong analytical, reporting and problem-solving skills.
-The ability to implement sustainable systems that reduce reliance on individual employees.

Mandatory Requirements

-Current NDIS Worker Screening Check.
-Current Working With Children Check.
-National Police Check.
-Current First Aid certificate.
-Full driver’s licence and access to a reliable vehicle.
-Full Australian working rights.

Desirable

-Relevant tertiary qualification in disability, social work, nursing, business or management.
-Experience overseeing multiple SIL homes.
-Strong knowledge of SCHADS Award obligations.
-Experience leading or preparing for NDIS audits.
-Experience implementing CRM, rostering or referral-tracking systems.

What We Offer

-Competitive salary reflecting the seniority and accountability of the position.
-Genuine decision-making authority within a senior leadership role.
-Direct access to executive leadership.
-The opportunity to strengthen systems and shape sustainable organisational growth.
-A clear pathway for progression as the organisation expands.
-A values-driven and participant-focused working environment.

Apply Now

If you are ready to take ownership of operational performance, strengthen compliance and build sustainable service-delivery systems, we invite you to apply.

Please submit your résumé and a cover letter outlining your NDIS operational leadership experience.

Job type: Full-time
Salary: $100,000–$120,000 per year, plus superannuation
Location: Western Sydney, NSW
Work arrangement: In person
